events.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
events.description: OPENS SEPT. 25 | Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

events.title: You Had to Be There
events.description: OPENS SEPTEMBER 25 | A documentary about the legendary 1972 Toronto production of the musical about the life of Jesus, which launched many illustrious careers and ignited a comedy revolution.

events.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
events.description: OPENS SEPTEMBER 18 | On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with mad science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

events.title: Primetime
events.description: OPENS SEPTEMBER 25 | In 2006, "To Catch a Predator" host Chris Hansen (Robert Pattinson) sets out to make television history.

events.title: Queer Chinese American & Canadian Voices – Sept. 28
events.description: SPECIAL EVENT | Monday, September 28 at 7:30pm | A showcase of four short films by filmmakers Jess X. Snow (Canada) and Janet Chen Ma (USA), followed by a live, virtual Q&A with the filmmakers.
